guards.rule: Never end the assistant turn on a routine progress sentence while competent work remains. Continue tool calls until a terminal status or a truthful STOP.
Do not stamp T4/24-of-24 before all mandatory probes have actually passed.
Record evidence-backed T0 before the first implementation or mutation.
At timebox expiry freeze actual state; post-timebox repairs remain separate and must not be backdated into the competitive result.
Do not call a chat-bound live preview a public evaluation route.
READY_FOR_REVIEW must include a real externally openable URL or explicitly mark the public route unverified/failed.
A user continue message is still a routine intervention even when no technical decision was made.
Post-run repair must never rewrite the historical competitive result, frozen branch, or original handoff as if the fix existed during the test.
Prefer product-focused portable delivery when generic scaffold is not materially required; do not claim a clean minimal repo if the shipped tree still contains unused platform chrome.
Put evidence, commit/ref and public URL in deterministic machine-readable handoff. Do not rely on Nano copy-paste.
